Our Story

Renzel's Story. Erika's Story. God's Story.

When God Was Preparing My Heart

I never imagined that helping my cousin message Erika would lead me to my future wife. I was 19, and she was 17 when our story began. We planned to wait until we turned 23 before entering a relationship, but our feelings grew, and we eventually became a couple. Through it all, God was preparing my heart and leading me closer to Him through music and worship.

I fell deeper in love with Erika because of her faith in God and her love for her family. Despite the challenges we faced, we continued choosing each other while keeping Jesus at the center. Today, I thank the Lord for His faithfulness, because the girl I once messaged for my cousin is now the woman I will marry.

When God’s Plans Are Greater Than My Own

Our love story began unexpectedly through Renzel’s cousin, who was my schoolmate. At 17, I wanted to focus on my studies, and love wasn’t part of my plans. Renzel was only supposed to help his cousin approach me, but through our everyday conversations, we slowly fell for each other.

What made me love him even more was the genuine care he showed my Lola Bebang. Through his kindness and actions, I saw a heart that reflected God’s love. Looking back, I believe the Lord was guiding our journey all along. As we begin our forever, my prayer is to always keep Jesus at the center of our marriage, trusting His will in every season.

His Perfect Plan, His Unfailing Grace

What began as a simple conversation became a beautiful journey of faith and love. We had our own plans, but God had a greater purpose for our lives. Through unexpected beginnings, changing seasons, and challenges, God continued to shape our hearts and draw us closer to Him.

Our journey was never perfect, but God’s grace remained constant. He taught us patience, forgiveness, commitment, and the beauty of choosing each other through every season. As we prepare to become husband and wife, we believe our story is a testimony of His faithfulness.

FAQ

  
Good to Know

  
What time should I arrive?
Kindly arrive at least 30 minutes before the ceremony. The ceremony starts at 4:00 PM.

  
Is parking available?
Large parking is available inside and outside Rai Atrium Suites Hotel. Upon arrival, the venue staff will assist you to Gawagaway-yan Hall 1.

  
Can I bring a plus one?
As we are hosting an intimate celebration, we respectfully ask that attendance be limited to the number of seats reserved for your invitation.

  
When is the RSVP deadline?
Please RSVP by November 15, 2026 so your seat can be prioritized.

  
Is there a dress code?
Yes. Kindly refer to the Dress Code section for our color palette and attire guide.

  
Will the ceremony be indoors?
Yes, both the ceremony and the reception will be indoors.

  
Who do I contact on the wedding day?
Contact us directly through John Renzel's Messenger.
